meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: Claude 会带你建好第一个 NanoClaw agent：确认你在该频道的身份、把这个 DM 消息组接到新 agent，并让它通过正常投递路径给你发一条欢迎私信，验证端到端是否打通。整个流程可重复运行。
howto.when: 在频道凭证已配置、服务正在运行之后使用；当你要为某个 DM 频道创建第一个 agent 时，它会接管并逐步询问。

say.text: 帮我初始化第一个 agent，频道选 Discord
say.note: 它会问你频道、用户 id、显示名和 agent 名

say.text: 用 Telegram 建第一个 NanoClaw agent
say.note: 它会解析 DM id 并接好消息组

say.text: 初始化第一个 agent，频道用 Slack，并帮我确认欢迎私信

howto.what_en: Claude walks you through creating the first NanoClaw agent: resolve your channel identity, wire the DM messaging group to a new agent, and have it send a welcome DM via the normal delivery path to verify end-to-end. Safe to rerun.
howto.when_en: Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running. It takes over when you want to create the first agent for a DM channel.

say_en.text: Set up my first agent on Discord
say_en.note: It asks for channel, user id, display name, agent name

say_en.text: Create my first NanoClaw agent on Telegram
say_en.note: It resolves the DM id and wires the agent group

say_en.text: Init the first agent on Slack and confirm the welcome DM
say_en.note: It waits for you to say the DM arrived
